command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/heritage-conservation/references/workflows/monitoring-maintenance.md && rg --files inputs outputs . | sed -n '1,160p' && printf '\\n--- packet ---\\n' && sed -n '1,320p' inputs/packet.md && printf '\\n--- git ---\\n' && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' outputs/monitoring.csv && sed -n '1,160p' outputs/maintenance.csv && awk -F',' 'NR==1 {n=NF; print \"monitoring columns=\" n; next} NF"'!=n {print "monitoring field-count mismatch at row " NR ": " NF}'"' outputs/monitoring.csv && awk -F',' 'NR==1 {n=NF; print \"maintenance columns=\" n; next} NF"'!=n {print "maintenance field-count mismatch at row " NR ": " NF}'"' outputs/maintenance.csv && rg -n \""'^# (Monitoring Context|Monitoring Register|Change And Trigger Findings|Maintenance Record|Follow-up Plan|Checks And Limits|Owner Questions|Files Changed|Handoffs)$" outputs/findings.md'

/bin/bash -lc "awk -F',' 'NR==1 {n=NF; next} NF"'!=n {bad=1; print "field-count mismatch " NR} $4 !~ /''^2026-09-(01|03|04)$/ {bad=1; print "unexpected monitoring date " NR ":" $4} END {if (!bad) print "monitoring.csv: 7 records; 20 fields per record; dates valid"; exit bad}'"' outputs/monitoring.csv
awk -F',' 'NR==1 {n=NF; next} NF"'!=n {bad=1; print "field-count mismatch " NR} $4 != "" && $4 !~ /''^2026-09-02$/ {bad=1; print "unexpected due date " NR ":" $4} $5 != "" && $5 !~ /''^2026-09-03$/ {bad=1; print "unexpected completion date " NR ":" $5} END {if (!bad) print "maintenance.csv: 2 records; 11 fields per record; dates valid"; exit bad}'"' outputs/maintenance.csv
rg -n 'M2.*\\+4 percentage points|M5.*\\+0\\.2 mm|M3.*missing|M7.*not comparable|T1.*unverified|T2.*completed' outputs/monitoring.csv outputs/maintenance.csv
find outputs -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\\n' | sort"
